## Code signing policy

Free code signing provided by [SignPath.io](https://about.signpath.io), certificate by [SignPath Foundation](https://signpath.org).

Windows EXE/DLL files built by this project and the Windows installer are signed through SignPath before packaging and upload. Third-party libraries are not re-signed with the project's certificate.

See the [code signing policy]({{CODE_SIGNING_POLICY_URL}}) for team roles, signing scope and privacy information.
